external_cm.note: Samsonite's own figure, given three times on the page as "Overall Dimensions", "Exterior Dimensions" and "External Dimensions": 22 x 14 x 9 in. Unexpanded. Not measured by us.

weight_kg.note: 5.07 lb on the page; the spec table rounds to 5.1 lb.

reviews.praise: Lightest full-size pick; resisted dents under the bat test.
reviews.caveat: No interior compartments; picked up cosmetic scratches.

conflicts.detail: Superseded by the manufacturer's own overall figure. The two agree to within 0.04 cm, so the earlier number was sound — it simply could not be recommended on.

Samsonite publishes an interior width of 9.06 in against an exterior width of 9 in. The inside of a suitcase cannot be wider than the outside. It is 1.5 mm and changes no verdict; recorded because it is why we never derive an external size from an internal one, not because it discredits the overall figure.

notes: Polycarbonate. Already in the catalogue on Travel + Leisure's measurement, which agreed with Samsonite to within a millimetre. Upgraded to the maker's own overall figure so it can be recommended rather than only displayed.

manufacturer_source.title: UpLIFT Hardside Carry-On Spinner — Samsonite US

expands_cm.note: "Expands 1-Inch". Compliant closed; the expander takes the depth to 25.4 cm.
